bounds: One app with one active and one superseded deployment. One rollback and one delete can interleave between their initial read and their guarded write. The projection assumes each database operation finishes atomically or rolls back its tentative changes. Upload, finalize, object removal, authorization, multiple activation writers, process recovery and replica lag are separate.

assumptions: No scheduling fairness. The deletion predicate is rechecked at write time. A failed promotion rolls back the demotion in the same transaction.
Weak fairness for each admitted write. The handler resumes after the initial read and the database accepts or rejects the write.
No scheduling fairness. A handler can stay suspended after reading.
